function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH purchase_agg AS (
  SELECT
    pl.period,
    pl.sku,
    SUM(pl.qty) AS po_qty,
    SUM(pl.amount_cad) AS po_amount_cad
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
  WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
  GROUP BY pl.period, pl.sku
),
sales_with_cost AS (
  SELECT
    sl.period,
    sl.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    c.channel,
    sl.sku,
    sl.qty,
    sl.revenue_cad,
    (sl.qty * pa.po_amount_cad / NULLIF(pa.po_qty,0)) AS cogs_cad
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN purchase_agg pa ON sl.sku = pa.sku AND sl.period = pa.period
  WHERE sl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
)
SELECT
  period,
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  channel,
  SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
  SUM(revenue_cad) AS total_revenue,
  SUM(cogs_cad) AS total_cogs,
  SUM(revenue_cad - cogs_cad) AS gross_margin
FROM sales_with_cost
GROUP BY period, customer_id, customer_name, channel
ORDER BY period, gross_margin DESC","purpose":"Compute gross margin per customer per period to see shifts"}
